{{Quote|This is the Corvis Minor system. The third and fourth planets are inhabited. The third is a semi-arid world with temperate zones at the poles, and the fourth is a water-rich tropical world. Both produce some exotic xenobiological products that sell as luxury commodities within the Hegemony and outside.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="XW" />}}
The '''Corvis Minor system''' in the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] contained seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Corvis Minor III]], [[Corvis Minor IV]], [[Corvis Minor V]], and the primary star [[Corvis Minor]]. An [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] was located beyond the fifth planet.<ref name="XW" />

The Corvis Minor system had a generally unremarkable history. Most [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] libraries had a box disguised as a multiple [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] set named ''[[The Complete History of Corvis Minor]]''. Contained within the box would be a small emergency [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

During his escape from the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] obtained a blaster from a Corvis Minor history box in [[Ysanne Isard]]'s private library onboard the ''Lusankya''. He noted that if a blaster was considered the complete history of the planet, then he didn't think it was a vacation spot.<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> Later, during the [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was able to use her knowledge of Imperial procedure to obtain a blaster from a library on a residential floor of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] when she realized the Palace had been infiltrated by Imperial agents.<ref name="TLC" />
